entities.name: Mahinda IV of Anuradhapura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mahinda IV was King of Anuradhapura in the 10th century, whose reign lasted from 975 to 991. He succeeded his brother Sena IV as King of Anuradhapura and was succeeded by his son Sena V.
